---
name: Protocol RFC
about: Propose a change to the swarm protocol or lesson format
labels: rfc
---

## Problem

What breaks or is missing today?

## Proposal

What should change? Include topic/payload examples.

## Alternatives

What else was considered and why is it worse?

## Privacy impact

Does this move raw data, identifiers or metadata off-device?

## Operator impact

Does this add cost, configuration or failure modes for node operators?

## Compatibility

Does this stay within v1 (additive) or require v2?

## Rollback

How do we undo it if it fails?
